The structure of Ho4Cu2Sn2O12 (reduced formula Ho2CuSnO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu and Sn centers, each with six oxygen neighbors, while Ho centers show eight oxygen neighbors and O centers show four neighbors (one Cu, one Ho, one Sn, and one O). Corner-sharing is observed between Cu and Sn octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cu or Sn octahedra and the eight-vertex Ho polyhedra; the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
